trust_decision.summary: Style-map text, which can come from an untrusted .docx (embedded part mammoth/style-map, read by default), is tokenised by a regex-based tokeniser; the string-token regex is ambiguous for backslash, so an unterminated string full of escapes backtracks exponentially.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names the style map tokeniser; the file is 30 lines and the string-prefix regex is the only nested-quantifier pattern in it.

fix_sites.entry_point: mammoth.convertToHtml / convertToMarkdown / convert (embedded style map or options.styleMap) and CLI --style-map, all via style-reader readStyle -> parseString -> tokenise (lib/style-reader.js:14-16, lib/style-reader.js:344-345, lib/index.js:71-72, lib/main.js:55-57)
fix_sites.module_kind: library-internal lexer (shared by every style-map parse)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Nothing to dismiss: every route goes through the single tokenise() call, so the one-line regex fix covers all of them.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Escaped quotes and backslashes inside quoted strings (e.g. [style-name='It\'s']) and unterminated-string tokens used for error reporting must keep tokenising the same; an over-broad fix that drops escapes or rejects unterminated strings breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: unterminated string ending with a lone backslash
unterminated string ending with an escaped quote

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Identifier regex built from an escape-or-char alternation; a variant where the char class also admits backslash would be ambiguous in the same way.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same author idiom (escape alternation inside a starred group) used right next to the fixed pattern; currently disjoint ([a-zA-Z\-_] vs \\.), so it is safe at the pinned commit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Escape-decoding regex over the same token text; a richer escape syntax (e.g. \u{...}) could add a backtracking pattern.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Decoding runs on every identifier/string token from the untrusted style map.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333) in a regex lexer for a user/document-supplied mini-language

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm (mocha tests; dependency lop ^0.4.2 provides RegexTokeniser)
O10_build.project_tests: test/styles/parser/tokeniser.tests.js, test/styles/document-matchers.tests.js, test/styles/html-paths.tests.js; style-reader tests under test/

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cap style-map line length or catch-all timeout instead of making the escape alternation unambiguous ([^'\\] plus \\(?:.|$)).

out_of_scope_notes: NEWS (fix.diff:33-34) says untrusted documents should still be processed in a separate thread with a timeout; other DoS vectors in docx parsing not pursued.
Prior advisories at 1.12.1/1.12.2 (prototype pollution in styles reading) are separate protections.
unverified: lop RegexTokeniser internals (how it combines/anchors regexes) not inspected: node_modules not present in the pinned tree.
